title: Uses of a public square
bodyMd: A designer proposes movable benches in a square rather than fixing every seat in one arrangement. She argues that users should be able to adjust the space for conversation, solitude, or shade. A maintenance officer notes that movable benches require storage during storms. The designer accepts that operational cost and asks for a trial, rather than claiming flexibility has no disadvantages.
